title.narrative: FTF Bangladesh Improving Trade and Business Enabling Environment Activity

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): The Feed the Future Bangladesh Improving Trade and Business Enabling Environment (BITBEE) activity is partnering with the GoB, the private sector, and other non-governmental partners to improve trade facilitation by implementing the World Trade Organization's Trade Facilitation Agreement, building the capacity of government officials, and improving food safety procedures. With FY 2022 funds, BITBEE will improve the business enabling environment through streamlining and simplifying processes and digitizing government services to ease business operations and make services more transparent and accessible. Reducing cross-border trade costs will increase trade flows, facilitate greater integration into regional and global value chains, increase transparency, enhance government revenues, curtail corrupt practices, strengthen partnerships with the private sector, and strengthen economic cooperation with regional and key trading partners. The activity will continue to work with the National Trade Facilitation Committee to adopt international best practices and ensure that businesses, especially those led by women, and disadvantaged groups, have a voice in the government's trade facilitation work. The activity will enhance citizen services, thereby creating a more efficient and transparent business enabling environment. An improved business enabling environment will encourage domestic and foreign direct investment.
